title: NACA 0012 airfoil
description: Symmetric airfoil at small angle of attack (incompressible lift slope) and a transonic condition M=0.8, alpha=1.25 deg (AGARD AR-138 family).

mesh.note: requires an airfoil C-grid generator (not yet implemented); geometry formula in reference/naca4_thickness.txt

reference.citation: I. H. Abbott, A. E. von Doenhoff, Theory of Wing Sections (1959); AGARD AR-138 (1979) for transonic surface-pressure data (consult the report for tabulated Cp).
reference.tolerance: lift slope within 5 percent of 0.11 per degree before stall (indicative)
